bullets.id: CPI Oktober lebih panas dari perkiraan: headline naik 0,4% (perkiraan 0,3%) dan inti 0,3% (perkiraan 0,2%). Emas spot turun 2,7% ke $4.028,39 pada Selasa sore waktu AS menurut Reuters, dan emas berjangka Desember ditutup turun 2,0% di $4.030,20 setelah sempat dibuka di $4.149. Pagi ini emas stabil di sekitar $4.042, naik tipis 0,24% menurut Trading Economics.
bullets.en: October CPI ran hotter than expected: headline rose 0.4% (forecast 0.3%) and core 0.3% (forecast 0.2%). Spot gold fell 2.7% to $4,028.39 on Tuesday afternoon US time according to Reuters, and December gold futures settled 2.0% lower at $4,030.20 after opening at $4,149. This morning gold is steady near $4,042, up a slim 0.24% according to Trading Economics.

bullets.id: Kenaikan bunga Fed Desember kini hampir pasti: Trading Economics mencatat peluangnya sekitar 91% dari 84%, dan peluang kenaikan 50 bps naik ke 10% dari 0% menurut CME FedWatch, setelah Gubernur Waller menyebut langkah setengah poin layak dipertimbangkan. Yield 10 tahun naik 10 bps ke 4,98% (sempat di atas 5%) dan indeks dolar naik 0,58% ke 102,25. Emas sekitar 27,9% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 dan turun 3,1% dalam sebulan.
bullets.en: A December Fed hike now looks almost certain: Trading Economics puts the odds near 91% from 84%, and the chance of a 50 bp hike rose to 10% from 0% on CME FedWatch, after Governor Waller said a half-point move should be considered. The 10-year yield rose 10 bp to 4.98% (briefly above 5%) and the dollar index rose 0.58% to 102.25. Gold is about 27.9% below its $5,608.35 record and down 3.1% on the month.

bullets.id: Level $4.000 kembali jadi support kritis, sebagaimana disebut Standard Chartered, sementara $4.150 yang gagal ditembus Senin kini menjadi resistance. Brent turun 1,17% ke $91,49 dan sempat di bawah $90 untuk pertama kali sejak Agustus, sedikit meredam tekanan inflasi energi. Berikutnya pasar menunggu PPI Jumat 13 November dan keputusan Fed 9 Desember.
bullets.en: The $4,000 level is again the critical support, as Standard Chartered notes, while $4,150, which Monday failed to break, is now resistance. Brent fell 1.17% to $91.49 and briefly dipped below $90 for the first time since August, slightly easing energy-inflation pressure. Next, markets await PPI on Friday 13 November and the Fed decision on 9 December.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram turun Rp30.000 ke Rp2.530.000 dengan buyback turun Rp37.000 ke Rp2.338.000, sehingga spread melebar ke Rp192.000 (sekitar 7,6%) dari 7,2%. Situs Galeri24 masih mencantumkan Galeri24 di Rp2.518.000 (buyback Rp2.370.000, spread sekitar 5,9%), hanya Rp12.000 lebih murah dari Antam, sedangkan UBS turun ke Rp2.542.000 (buyback Rp2.344.000, spread sekitar 7,8%).
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price fell Rp30,000 to Rp2,530,000 with buyback down Rp37,000 to Rp2,338,000, widening the spread to Rp192,000 (about 7.6%) from 7.2%. The Galeri24 site still lists Galeri24 at Rp2,518,000 (buyback Rp2,370,000, a spread of about 5.9%), only Rp12,000 cheaper than Antam, while UBS fell to Rp2,542,000 (buyback Rp2,344,000, a spread of about 7.8%).
